# Sheriff McGuffey and members of the HCSO Command Staff attend the Policing Forum

Sheriff McGuffey and members of the HCSO Command Staff were proud to attend and support the Center for Social Justice’s Forum on Policing in Hamilton County. This very important effort will provide crucial data that will help shape policy to improve policing operations across Hamilton County.

Chief Deputy Jay Gramke, Major Jackie Reed, and Public Information Officer Kyla Woods were in attendance with Sheriff McGuffey.

Mt. Healthy’s Police Chief, Vince DeMasi, participated in the panel on behalf of Law Enforcement
